identity: authId references Auth users.id logically; never use profile.id for ownership

update.omitted: preserve existing value; new profile defaults null
update.missingProfile: find-or-create; immediate create response omits unspecified fields, later GET includes nulls
update.createAuthIdType: URL PUT echoes decimal string; /me PUT uses numeric JWT id; later DB lookup returns number

timestamps: UTC ISO 8601 milliseconds with Z; legacy DATETIME reloads at second precision
intentionalDivergences: Only Bearer and HS256 accepted; legacy middleware accepted other schemes/HS algorithms
Malformed profile field types and noninteger identities return controlled errors
Unexpected DB errors are sanitized; GET /me still preserves empty 200 for lookup failures
